sourcing_note: Candidates added after the M7 handoff specifically to address the confirmed shortfalls in PHASE_3_PIVOTAL, the negative-event reserve, and CONFERENCE_OTHER once the pre-existing 179-candidate acquisition pool was fully worked through. Sourced via targeted primary-source research (web search cross-checked against SEC EDGAR and issuer press releases), not the broken discovery pipeline. Each candidate is deduplicated against the full existing ticker/candidate_id set before inclusion. No candidate here was selected or excluded based on its post-event stock outcome - inclusion is based solely on being a genuine, verifiable, in-window (2018-01-01 through 2025-12-31) US-listed therapeutic-biotech disclosure event; whether it then passes the historical-universe investability floor is a separate, later determination.

events.timestamp_ambiguity: Neither the SEC exhibit nor available mirrors display an explicit release clock time; the SEC 8-K acceptance timestamp (17:15:25 ET, after the 16:00 close) is used as the primary-source proxy. Session classification (OUTSIDE_MARKET_HOURS_AFTER_CLOSE, cutoff = the same day's already-completed regular session) is not sensitive to the exact minute.
events.universe_result_preview: FAILS the liquidity floor (20-session median dollar volume well under $2,000,000) as of the 2018-04-09 cutoff; recorded in historical-universe-ledger-29.json. Does not currently help the Phase III or negative-event shortfall, but is preserved as evidence of a genuine, non-cherry-picked sourcing attempt.
